title: Alternative geometry from resolved circular and noncircular MaNGA kinematics
hypothesis: A positive, locally screened torsion, nonmetricity, direction-dependent, or affine geometric kernel with universal parameters predicts held-out circular and noncircular Halpha motion from baryons beyond strong ordinary source-geometry controls and transfers unchanged to stellar noncircular motion.

discovery_policy.universal_gravity_track: Require one unchanged action-eligible geometric kernel and universal parameters to beat baryonic, structural, flexible, and ordinary source-geometry controls on circular and noncircular gas motion, transfer without kernel reselection to stellar noncircular motion, retain a positive bounded quadratic response and local GR limit, and remain eligible for later lensing and relativistic completion.
discovery_policy.phenomenon_publication_track: Retain a reproducible response-blind relation between continuum-derived geometric invariants and resolved noncircular motion beyond ordinary morphology and radial controls even if it is not evidence for non-Riemannian gravity.

theory_sources.boundary: The teleparallel equivalent of GR is a known reformulation with the same field equations; torsion language alone is not new physics, so Item 37 requires a nonlinear screened response distinguishable from the TEGR boundary-term rewrite.
f(T) gravity is a known modified-torsion family with extensive cosmological and astrophysical prior art; the bounded galaxy projection here is not a solved tetrad field equation.
Coincident GR is a known symmetric-teleparallel reformulation; nonmetricity by itself is not a physical deviation from GR.
A nonlinear nonmetricity action reproducing MOND-like galactic behavior is published prior art; any selected acceleration-only projection must not be claimed as a new geometry law.

Action-based Finsler spacetime gravity and its metric limit are known; Item 37 uses only a bounded direction-dependent observational projection, not the unit-tangent-bundle field equations or their null structure.

Complete quadratic metric-affine actions contain many torsion and nonmetricity invariants and hypermomentum effects; the baryon-affine holonomy lane is a potentially new observational synthesis, not proof of historical novelty or a complete metric-affine solution.

independence.rule: Reconstruct the Item 36 response-blind fresh disk pool, then exclude every Item 36 exploration or confirmation role and every additional neighbor within 60 arcseconds before mass quartiles, roles, folds, MAPS downloads, source thresholds, or velocity access.

sample.stratification: four exactly equal response-blind stellar-mass rank quartiles after every predecessor and coordinate veto; 37 selected per quartile with seven sealed confirmations and 30 exploration objects, exactly six exploration objects per fold per quartile

derived_predictors.torsion_proxy: bounded product of continuum nonaxisymmetry, normalized radius, and enclosed-mass slope
derived_predictors.nonmetricity_proxy: bounded radial mismatch between enclosed-mass slope and the inverse-square metric-source expectation
derived_predictors.Finsler_anisotropy_proxy: bounded continuum directional amplitude multiplied by projected flattening
derived_predictors.affine_holonomy_proxy: bounded geometric mean of torsion and nonmetricity proxies modulated by centroid displacement

response.circular_amplitude: absolute c1 deprojected by the frozen photometric inclination for Halpha

physics.action_proxy: S_eff=(16*pi*G)^-1 integral sqrt(-g)[T+f_T(T,Z_b), Q+f_Q(Q,Z_b), L_F(x,y,Z_b), or R(gamma)+quadratic(T,Q,Z_b)] with universal coefficients, reduced only to a positive bounded two-channel response kernel
physics.variation_proxy: The frozen weak-field projection multiplies baryonic circular response by mu_geometry and transports source harmonics by mu_mode/mu_circular; circular delta log10(v)=0.5*log10(mu_geometry).
physics.conservation_proxy: positive bounded response eigenvalues, tracer-independent coupling, parity-even source scalars, and an explicit metric limit; this is only a quadratic effective-action proxy, not complete diffeomorphism, local-Lorentz, projective, or hypermomentum identities
physics.equivalence_principle_proxy: kernel is independent of tracer mass and composition; unchanged Halpha-to-stellar transfer tests but does not prove universality
physics.GR_boundary: TEGR and coincident GR are exactly equivalent descriptions of GR; only nonlinear or direction-dependent terms can be counted as modified geometry, and every circular projection is compared with an ordinary source-geometry force rewrite
physics.lensing_boundary: No null-geodesic or gravitational-slip law is derived in Item 37; later direct lensing is mandatory

equivalence_boundaries: TEGR and coincident GR are alternative representations of GR, not new laws; their exact equivalence regions are controls.
f(T), nonlinear f(Q), and Finsler gravity are known theory families; selected cells cannot be described as independent discoveries.
Every circular snapshot correction is compared with ordinary radial, morphology, acceleration, and source-geometry hinges; fit does not identify geometry.
The baryon-affine lane is only a potentially new synthesis until action derivation, behavioral equivalence, prior-art, lensing, stability, and independent-data gates pass.
Snapshot harmonics are not complete tetrads, connections, autoparallels, null cones, or covariant field solutions.
Raw parameter cells are not independent laws; behavioral equivalence classes are counted separately and provenance labels never prune.
